instruction: It needs to read newest pr not always 97
scope: Discover the newest PR by creation time across all states for repo-link and Pages-link role commands. An explicit PR URL selects that PR.
Remove the fixed report from the public manifest. Give web-only and browser API clients the live discovery URL.
Read the selected PR detail and present its current head, report comparison and head-pinned handoff. Preserve the existing source archive catalog.
validation: Desktop HTTP and JavaScript contracts passed, including frozen CLI fixtures for newest PR, explicit override, stale report, fork handoff and empty listing.
Both terminal paths read the live GitHub API and matched the newest PR and explicit historical override. Infrastructure and generated handoff checks are checked locally.
limitations: The page-local API returns discovery metadata for an optional public GET. Terminal role commands perform the lookup themselves.
Discovery uses creation time rather than comment or edit activity. Audit an unmatched report against HANDOFF.md at the actual PR head.
next_steps: Use the newest PR returned by the API before reading its Betty report. Supply a specific PR link to continue a different track.
